task:
Finder PR F4d: custom archetype weight sliders (V3 /rerank), URL-only.

Read docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-10-v3-finder-f4-archetype-ui-design.md section 8 "PR F4d — V3 custom weights, only after F3 slice 2" (exact file list) and section 9. Its prerequisites are met: F3 slice 2 merged (#862), so POST /api/archetypes/rerank is V3-backed, and the generated client already has postArchetypeRerankApiArchetypesRerankPost. The request model is ArchetypeRerankRequest in apps/api/src/models.py: id64s (1–500), optional archetype, optional weights (ArchetypeRerankWeights: all eight V3 keys paradise, mining_hub, manufacturing_hub, megacomplex, research_hub, stronghold, population_capital, flexible; each 0–1; at least one > 0; extra keys forbidden), optional profile. GET /api/archetypes/profiles lists preset blends. Do not change the API or regenerate the client unless the drift check requires it.

OWNER ANSWER, question 2 (2026-11-01): custom weights are URL-ONLY. They live in the Explore URL so a shared or bookmarked link keeps them; they are NOT remembered in local storage, cookies or the persistence layer, and opening /explore fresh starts from the default weights. Record this answer in section 9 "Owner answers" of the F4 design (dated 2026-11-01) and add a short status update in section 1.

Build:
1. ArchetypeWeightsPopover.svelte (+ test): a pop-out panel (non-modal dialog, Escape/close/outside click close it, focus returns to its trigger, centred sheet under ~640px wide) opened from a "Weights" button beside the archetype picker. Eight labelled range sliders (0–100% in 5% steps, each with a visible numeric value and an accessible name), preset buttons from GET /api/archetypes/profiles, "Reset to default", and an "Apply" button. Apply is disabled with an explanation when every weight is 0. Plain-English labels via the existing archetypeLabel().
2. ranking-state.ts (+ test): parse and serialize a bounded `weights` URL parameter (eight values in a fixed key order, each an integer 0–100, at least one > 0; anything malformed is dropped by canonicalization exactly as other invalid ranking params are). Weights are only meaningful in Any mode or alongside the selected archetype as defined by the design; follow the design's rules and keep the existing canonical-URL behaviour.
3. client.ts / query.ts (+ tests): a facade for /rerank that sends the current page's id64s (≤ 500) with weights converted to 0–1, validates the response fail-closed like the other facades, and a query key that includes every weight and the id64 list. Bounded: one rerank request per committed weights/page change, none while the popover is only being dragged.
4. ExploreWorkspace.svelte (+ test): when committed weights are present, show the reranked order and blended score with a clear "Custom weights" chip that opens the popover and a one-click "Clear weights"; when absent, behaviour is unchanged. Rerank failures leave the unweighted results visible with a short message. Keep the empty-on-load rule from the explore-empty-on-load change if it has merged to main by the time you start (no requests with no anchor/Any/no URL state).
5. Cypress product-journey.cy.ts: open the popover, move a slider, apply, assert the URL carries weights, the order/score update from a stubbed or fixture /rerank, reload keeps weights, a fresh /explore has none, and axe passes on the open popover. Keep intercept aliases unique.
6. CHANGES.md entry. Run pnpm check, pnpm test and pnpm build in apps/web.

All behind the existing VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED flag; with the flag off nothing changes.
